summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the scrip dividend reference price for its 2025/26 final dividend. The scrip reference price for ordinary shareholders is 1,197.70 pence per share, and for ADR holders is US$80.5453 per ADR, calculated using the average closing mid-market price over five dealing days following the ex-dividend date. The filing includes the full dividend timetable: ex-dividend date 28 May 2026 (ordinary) and 29 May 2026 (ADRs), record date 29 May 2026, and payment on 23 July 2026. This is a routine dividend mechanics update, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
